corrected_value.title: Judgment under uncertainty: Heuristics and biases.

decisions.quote:
The two
final standard anchoring trials were added to the survey
flow after all the incidental trials. These items enabled a
replication of the classic anchoring procedure designed by
Tversky and Kahneman (1974).
decisions.reason: No prior adjudication or state file exists for this work. In Studies 2 and 3, the authors empirically administer standard comparative-plus-estimation anchoring trials alongside incidental anchoring items, explicitly stating in Study 2 Method (p. 6) that these items enabled a replication of the classic anchoring procedure designed by Tversky and Kahneman (1974) and reporting robust anchoring effects in the Results of Studies 2 and 3 (pp. 6, 8) and the Meta-Analysis (pp. 9-10). The reference list (p. 15) and Crossref metadata identify the original as Tversky, A., & Kahneman, D. (1974), 'Judgment under uncertainty: Heuristics and biases,' Science, 185, 1124-1131, DOI 10.1126/science.185.4157.1124. This classic standard anchoring paper is completely distinct from shipped rows 1475 (Critcher & Gilovich, 2007/2008, DOI 10.1002/bdm.586) and 1494 (Dogerlioglu-Demir & Koçaş, 2014/2015, DOI 10.1007/s11002-014-9295-0) as well as sibling target 2 (Koçaş & Dogerlioglu-Demir, 2020, DOI 10.1016/j.jbusres.2019.01.027), all of which test incidental environmental anchoring.
